Augment Cohort Data with TMLE Nuisance Predictions and EIF Diagnostics

Source: R/tidymodels_verbs.R
augment.tmle_fit.Rd

Appends initial and targeted counterfactual predictions (.q0_init, .q1_init, .q0_star, .q1_star), raw and truncated propensity scores (.g_hat, .g_trunc), clever covariates (.clever_h), targeted individual treatment effects (.ite_star), Efficient Influence Function values (.eif), and fractional EIF variance leverage (.eif_leverage).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'tmle_fit'
augment(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted "tmle_fit" object.

...

Currently unused.

Value

A tibble::tibble() matching the input data (or selected subgroup).

Details

Column Decoder Ring

  • .q0_init, .q1_init: Initial cross-fitted outcome predictions \(\bar{Q}^0(0, W)\) and \(\bar{Q}^0(1, W)\) before targeting (G-computation predictions).

  • .q0_star, .q1_star: Targeted TMLE counterfactual predictions \(\bar{Q}^*(0, W)\) and \(\bar{Q}^*(1, W)\) after fluctuating along the Clever Covariate.

  • .g_hat, .g_trunc: Raw cross-fitted propensity scores \(P(A = 1 \mid W)\) and scores truncated to g_bounds.

  • .clever_h: The Clever Covariate \(H_n(A, W)\) linking propensity and censoring weights to the parameter's Efficient Influence Function (Luque-Fernandez et al., 2018).

  • .ite_star: Individual targeted treatment contrast \(\bar{Q}^*(1, W_i) - \bar{Q}^*(0, W_i)\).

  • .eif, .eif_leverage: Observation-level Efficient Influence Function contribution \(D_i^*\) and variance share \({D_i^*}^2 / \sum {D_j^*}^2\).

References

Luque-Fernandez, M. A., Schomaker, M., Rachet, B., & Schnitzer, M. E. (2018). Targeted maximum likelihood estimation for a binary treatment: A tutorial. Statistics in Medicine, 37(16), 2530–2546.
